description: an old man archdruid with a long white beard braided with green leaves, a grand crown of tall antlers entwined with ivy and glowing green leaves, robes of moss, bark and oak leaves, a mantle of oak leaves and ivy, a belt of roots, a gnarled living-wood staff with a glowing green light held upright in his right hand, seen from the side in strict profile: the face, chest, hips and feet all turned fully to the right, only one eye visible, facing and walking to the right, upright mid-step in the pose of the grey mannequin, the same size and place as the mannequin, the whole figure from the top of the head to the feet inside the image, isolated figure on a plain background, forest fantasy

references.usage: the character's look: face, hair, clothes, colours and what the hands hold
the pose, size and place of the figure: seen from the side, facing right, upright mid-step; copy it exactly
